title: finalVerification runs on the phase-terminal node, never before
proves: finalVerificationCommands in final-verification.mjs appends contract.finalVerification only to the one node no other node depends on; every other node's own controller verification never sees it. A two-node chain (build, then ship depending on build) whose finalVerification command can only pass once ship's own worker has run proves the ordering two ways at once: if finalVerification ran on build (before ship exists) the command would find nothing and build would fail verification instead of reaching done, and the run would never even reach ship; with the fix build closes on its own taskPacket verification alone and only ship's controller verification carries the extra command, which by then finds what ship's own worker just wrote.

contract.goal: prove finalVerification runs only on the phase-terminal node
